connector.name: X402 Ads MCP
connector.registryDescription: x402 ad recommendations, intent analytics, and machine-commerce demand reports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package x402-ads-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the forgemeshlabs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Optional dedicated low-balance Base wallet private key for settling paid x402 analytics calls. Without it, paid tools return the x402 payment challenge instead of settling.

env.name: X402_ADS_PUBLISHER_KEY
env.description: Optional publisher key from ads.forgemesh.io. Makes get_intent_report free for your registered services.

env.name: X402_ADS_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional intent network base URL. Defaults to https://ads.forgemesh.io.

env.name: BASE_RPC_URL
env.description: Optional Base mainnet RPC URL. Defaults to https://mainnet.base.org.
